activities.name: Eiffel Tower Summit Access
activities.description: Ascend to the summit of the iconic Eiffel Tower for panoramic 360-degree views over Paris.

activities.name: Louvre Museum Masterpieces Tour
activities.description: Explore the world's greatest art museum including the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory.

activities.name: Seine River Evening Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Gourmet 3-course French dining while gliding past illuminated Parisian monuments.

activities.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Walking Tour
activities.description: Discover bohemian alleys, artist squares, and the highest point in Paris.

activities.name: Colosseum & Roman Forum VIP Tour
activities.description: Step back into ancient gladiatorial history with skip-the-line arena access.

activities.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
activities.description: Marvel at Michelangelo's ceiling frescoes and the immense Papal collections.

activities.name: Trastevere Street Food & Wine Crawl
activities.description: Taste authentic Roman suppli, crispy pizza al taglio, artisan gelato, and regional wines.

activities.name: teamLab Planets Immersive Digital Art
activities.description: Walk through water and dynamic digital light installations in Toyosu.

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Gourmet Food Tour
activities.description: Sample fresh sashimi, wagyu skewers, tamagoyaki, and matcha desserts.

activities.name: Mount Fuji & Hakone Day Trip
activities.description: Scenic bus ride to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Lake Ashi pirate boat cruise, and Hakone ropeway.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine Thousand Torii Gates
activities.description: Hike through thousands of bright vermillion torii gates winding up sacred Mount Inari.

activities.name: Traditional Tea Ceremony Experience
activities.description: Learn the zen philosophy and rituals of authentic Japanese matcha preparation.

activities.name: Sagrada Família Fast-Track & Towers Tour
activities.description: Marvel at Antoni Gaudí's masterpiece basilica, soaring stained-glass light, and tower views.

activities.name: Tapas & Flamenco Show in Gothic Quarter
activities.description: Passionate live flamenco performance accompanied by sangria and traditional tapas.

activities.name: Tower of London & Crown Jewels
activities.description: Historic fortress, Beefeater tour, Raven guards, and the dazzling Crown Jewels.

activities.name: London Eye Observation Pod
activities.description: Soar 135 meters above the River Thames for views of Big Ben and Parliament.

activities.name: Canal Ring Cruise with Cheese & Drinks
activities.description: Glide along UNESCO world heritage canals passing 17th-century merchant houses.

activities.name: Zaanse Schans Windmills Bike Tour
activities.description: Cycle through Dutch countryside, historic working windmills, and clog workshops.

activities.name: Burj Khalifa At The Top (124th & 125th Floor)
activities.description: Ride high-speed elevators up the world's tallest tower for unmatched desert & ocean vistas.

activities.name: Desert 4x4 Dune Bashing & BBQ Camp
activities.description: Thrilling dune drive, camel riding, sandboarding, falconry, and barbecue under the stars.

activities.name: Giza Pyramids & Sphinx Camel Trek
activities.description: Marvel at the Great Pyramid of Khufu and the Sphinx on a traditional guided camel trek.

activities.name: Grand Egyptian Museum & King Tut Treasures
activities.description: Explore the brand new museum housing the complete collection of Tutankhamun's gold treasures.

activities.name: Christ the Redeemer & Corcovado Train
activities.description: Ride the historic cog train through Tijuca forest to the foot of Christ the Redeemer.

activities.name: Sugarloaf Mountain Sunset Cable Car
activities.description: Two-stage panoramic cable car ride with stunning views over Guanabara Bay and Copacabana.

activities.name: Table Mountain Aerial Cableway
activities.description: Rotating cable car ride to the flat summit of Table Mountain for 360-degree Atlantic views.

activities.name: Boulders Beach African Penguin Colony
activities.description: Walk along wooden boardwalks just feet away from thousands of wild African penguins in Simons Town.

activities.name: Lake Zurich Steamboat Cruise & Old Town
activities.description: Scenic boat cruise across Lake Zurich followed by a guided stroll through cobblestone Altstadt alleys.

activities.name: Lindt Home of Chocolate Tasting Experience
activities.description: Marvel at the world's largest chocolate fountain and taste infinite artisanal Swiss truffles.

activities.name: Blue Lagoon Geothermal Spa & Silica Mud
activities.description: Soak in milky-blue volcanic thermal waters surrounded by moss-covered lava fields.

activities.name: Golden Circle & Northern Lights Hunt
activities.description: Visit Thingvellir National Park, Gullfoss waterfall, Strokkur geyser, and chase the magical Aurora Borealis.
